flagship_project.name: Project WealthEngine: AI-Autonomous Retail Portfolio Rebalancer, Global Direct Market Access & Sovereign Multi-Asset Custody Core
flagship_project.pillar: Automated Multi-Asset Wealth Optimization & Distributed Portfolio Ledger
flagship_project.strategic_thesis: Groww manages India's largest retail active client base in stock broking. WealthEngine implements an autonomous real-time quantitative portfolio rebalancer that continuously monitors tax-harvesting opportunities, ETF arbitrage, and automated SIP capital deployment for 40M+ retail portfolios simultaneously.
flagship_project.tech_stack: Go (High-Concurrency Trading Microservices), Java (Spring Boot Core Banking/Demats), Apache Cassandra (High-Write Portfolio History), Redpanda (Event Stream), ClickHouse, Kubernetes on Bare Metal
flagship_project.kpis: Real-time execution of 10M concurrent automated portfolio tax-harvesting runs; 99.995% execution reliability on NSE/BSE colocation; $25B+ assets under tracking.
